validation_notes: The right side of the chart (mid-June through July) shows price oscillating in a tight, roughly flat range between ~72 and ~80, but there's no clear convergence - highs and lows are both flattening in parallel rather than converging toward an apex. This looks more like a horizontal consolidation/range or a slight descending drift than a symmetric triangle with clearly converging trendlines. The algorithm likely picked up on the general narrowing of volatility after the June 30 spike, but there isn't a well-defined pair of angled trendlines meeting at a point - the recent candles (last 3 weeks) are essentially flat and choppy without a clean rising support or falling resistance line with 2-3 distinct touches each. I don't see enough structure to call this a credible triangle setup.
